## Display Module

LaTeX equation rendering and formatting

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [show_eqn](show_eqn.qmd#keecas.display.show_eqn) | Display mathematical equations as formatted LaTeX amsmath block. |
| [check](check.qmd#keecas.display.check) | Engineering verification function with localized pass/fail indicators. |
| [format_decimal_numbers](format_decimal_numbers.qmd#keecas.display.format_decimal_numbers) | Format all decimal numbers in a LaTeX string with specified precision. |

## Dataframe Module

Custom dictionary-like container for tabular equation data

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Dataframe](Dataframe.qmd#keecas.dataframe.Dataframe) | Custom dictionary-like container for tabular equation data. |
| [create_dataframe](create_dataframe.qmd#keecas.dataframe.create_dataframe) | Create a pre-sized Dataframe with specified shape and initial values. |

## Pipe Commands

Wraps common SymPy functions as decorators for functional composition

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [parse_expr](parse_expr.qmd#keecas.pipe_command.parse_expr) | Parse mathematical expression strings into SymPy symbolic objects. |
| [subs](subs.qmd#keecas.pipe_command.subs) | Substitute variables in symbolic expressions with values or other expressions. |
| [convert_to](convert_to.qmd#keecas.pipe_command.convert_to) | Convert quantities to different units while preserving values. |
| [N](N.qmd#keecas.pipe_command.N) | Numerically evaluate symbolic expressions to floating-point values. |
| [doit](doit.qmd#keecas.pipe_command.doit) | Evaluate unevaluated operations in symbolic expressions. |
| [quantity_simplify](quantity_simplify.qmd#keecas.pipe_command.quantity_simplify) | Simplify expressions with units by combining and reducing quantities. |

## Pint-SymPy Bridge

Integrates Pint unit registry with SymPy symbolic expressions by adding method `_sympy_` to `pint.Quantity` and `pint.Unit`

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [pint_to_sympy](pint_to_sympy.qmd#keecas.pint_sympy.pint_to_sympy) | Convert Pint quantities to SymPy expressions with units. |
| [SymPyUnitCache](SymPyUnitCache.qmd#keecas.pint_sympy.SymPyUnitCache) | Cache for dynamically created SymPy units to avoid redundant creation. |
| [update_pint_locale](update_pint_locale.qmd#keecas.pint_sympy.update_pint_locale) | Update Pint unit formatter locale for international unit names. |
